name: 0.7.0-alpha
body:
> [!WARNING]
> This version has breaking changes! More details below.

## Breaking Changes

- **config**: Drop early config options the SDL window no longer reads *[commit by @Rongmario in d150534]*
  - ForgeEarlyConfig has removed fields
- Renamed kirino submodule *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*

## Comprehensive

- Project overhaul (CleanroomGradle, LWJGLY, SDL 3) *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*

## Feature

- **input**: Minecraft::getFrameDeltaSeconds, use it for MouseTurnEvent *[commit by @Rongmario in fa7835a]*
- MouseTurnEvent *[PR by @ndellagrotte, Claude Opus 5.5 in #641]*
- **cache**: Caching API *[PR by @Rongmario in #636]*
- Optimize NBTTagCompound and add builder-like methods *[PR by @gardenevery in #655]*
- **lwjgl**: Added `freetype` module *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*
- **inputs**: Added SDL 3, replacing GLFW *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*
- **inputs**: Native IME support *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*
- **inputs**: Added inline IME when writing in books and signs *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*
- **taskbar**: Implemented efficient taskbar flashing *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*
- **window**: Implemented theme change events *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*
- **window**: Proper borderless & normal fullscreen support *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*
- **kirino**: New font rendering techniques *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*
- Make EventBus works without EventSubscriberTransformer *[PR by @ZZZank in #618]*

## Bug Fix

- **sdl**: Fall back through OpenGL versions when creating the context *[commit by @Rongmario in 56c6357]*
- **deps**: Erroneous configs leading to userdev not finding some libraries *[commit by @Rongmario in f1cd20d]*
- **event**: Keep re-entrant target changes and honor cancel in LivingSetAttackTargetEvent *[commit by @Rongmario in 7271d26]*
    *[Fixes issue #535 by @ThatBabu]*
    *[Fixes issue #545 by @Natedogwoooof]*
- **discovery**: Scan the loader's class directory as a classpath candidate *[commit by @Rongmario in b31209f]*
- **build**: Fork isolatedTest only for isolated test classes *[commit by @Rongmario in 0244150]*
    *[Fixes issue #635 by @Kuba663]*
- **discovery**: Keep the loader jar as a classpath candidate *[commit by @Rongmario in 27335c1]*
- **discovery**: Decide classpath libraries by content, not by name *[commit by @Rongmario in 9675aa4]*
- **lwjgl**: Make sure LWJGL2 only exists in the production runtime *[commit by @Rongmario in 7638742]*
- **at**: Remap mods at runtime in dev properly *[commit by @Rongmario in 56422ea]*
- **sdl**: Place the text field caret from drawTextBox's own layout *[commit by @Rongmario in 43ac715]*
    *[Fixes issue #646 by @geyesborg]*
- **sdl**: Drive IME state from the drawn screen and project text field carets *[commit by @Rongmario in dfda99c]*
- **sdl**: Rewind SDL-allocated buffers before SDL_free *[PR by @ndellagrotte, Claude Opus 5.5 in #642]*
- **command**: Drop chat sent to a player while tab-completing their input *[commit by @Rongmario in 36aa3a7]*
    *[Fixes issue #640 by @NielsPilgaard]*
- **chat**: Cycle suggestions backward with Shift+Tab and resume only on edits *[commit by @Rongmario in 917292a]*
- **chat**: Keep Up and Down on history and cycle suggestions with Tab *[commit by @Rongmario in 6573c55]*
    *[Fixes issue #623 by @Wizzerinus]*
- **sas**: Strip client-only markers from model classes again *[commit by @Rongmario in 74f4e37]*
- **gradle**: Stop run tasks from inheriting mixin debug args by default *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*
- **taskbar**: Native handle cleaned up *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*
- **ime**: Remove previous IME hacks *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*
- **patch**: `World#setBlockState` hunk regression *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*
- **patch**: `WorldGenTaiga1` & `WorldGenTaiga2` hunk regressions *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*
- **patch**: `WorldGenTrees` patch regression *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*
- **patch**: `WorldGeneratorBonusChest` hunk regression *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*
- **patch**: `BlockVine` hunk regression *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*
- **patch**: `BlockPistonStructureHelper` hunk regression *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*
- **patch**: Patch regression for `StructureVillagePieces` *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*
- **awt**: Reduce AWT initializations, breaks in android and other headless setups *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*

## Refactor

- **mod-list**: Reuse GuiUtils and vanilla button textures *[PR by @RuiXuqi, Rongmario in #651]*
- **debug**: Display proper LWJGL version, remove monitor/power info *[commit by @Rongmario in bfa4943]*
- **gradle**: Drop the boot launchers for CleanroomGradle 0.18.0 *[commit by @Rongmario in 0af24d8]*
- Rewritten buildscripts *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*
- Removed `buildSrc/` *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*
- Modularized different portions of the project *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*
- Moved licenses to respective modules *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*
- **hack**: Welcome back ImagineBreaker *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*
- **lwjgl**: Remove `tinyfd` module *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*
- **patch**: Removed unnecessary/verbose patches *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*
- **patch**: Remove redundant `SideOnly` patches with SAS *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*
- **patch**: New non-LZMA `ClassPatchManager` *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*
- **window**: Use SDL 3 methods to open links & files *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*

## Documentation

- New comprehensive and relevant `README` *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*
- Update CHANGELOG.md for 0.6.13-alpha [skip ci] *[commit by @kappa-maintainer in 19b9fa8]*

## Testing

- **junit**: Updated to JUnit 6 *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*

## Build and Dependencies

- Store gradlew.bat with LF in the index so tag builds see a clean worktree *[commit by @Rongmario in 6e5da28]*
- **deps**: Update CleanroomGradle to 0.20.0 *[commit by @Rongmario in c0728e6]*
- **maven**: Disable javadocs & duplicated sources from being published for now *[commit by @Rongmario in 6d3192e]*
- Move kirino run to cleanroom runs tasks group *[commit by @Rongmario in 99fc782]*
- **deps**: Update CleanroomGradle to 0.19.0 *[commit by @Rongmario in acc97d1]*
- **deps**: Update cleanmix to 0.7.3 *[commit by @Rongmario in 79a2a1b]*
- **deps**: Update foundation to 0.22.0 *[commit by @Rongmario in 21ef6d0]*
- Update Conventions to 1.4.0 *[commit by @Rongmario in a5292ca]*
- Bump conventions to 1.1.9 and format the cleanroom and builtin modules *[commit by @Rongmario in 6e9b4c1]*
- Adopt the full Cleanroom Conventions *[commit by @Rongmario in 64abc92]*
- Separate run task for kirino enabled client environment + CG update *[commit by @Rongmario in 4ba7234]*
- Update CG to 0.17.3 *[commit by @Rongmario in 6b4dd0e]*
- Adopt Conventions base plugin and shared workflows *[commit by @Rongmario in b4e122b]*
- Excluded `com.ibm.icu:icu4j-core-mojang`, `com.mojang:patchy` *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*
- Exclude LWJGL 2 natives from runtime *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*
- Remove google's `jsr305`, documented jakarta/java 8's javax differences *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*
- Add `ca.weblite:java-objc-bridge:1.2` back *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*

## Other

- --------- *[PR by @Rongmario, tttsaurus in #606]*

## First-time Contributors

- **@ndellagrotte made their first contribution!**
- **@gardenevery made their first contribution!**

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/CleanroomMC/Cleanroom/compare/0.6.13-alpha...0.7.0-alpha
